C9000327.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 327 (Markov type characterizes superreflexivity.; papers: Nontrivial Markov Type Forces Superreflexivity; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/327.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

CMain.statement: Every real Banach space with Markov type p for some p > 1 is superreflexive (staged thm:main).

COrdered.statement: A nonsuperreflexive real Banach space finitely represents a spreading-invariant norm on real c00 with contractive adjacent merging (lem:ordered-norm and Appendix A).

CEdgeTransfer.statement: Markov type controls sums of arbitrary odd labels on a finite stationary reversible marked chain with the same constant (lem:edge-labels).

CWalk.statement: For every spreading-invariant norm N on real c00 with contractive adjacent merging and every integer n >= 1, there is a finite stationary reversible marked chain with odd labels of N-norm one, contained in one finite coordinate span, and n-step escape probability at least 3/20 at distance n/24 (prop:walks).

CChartTransport.statement: Finite Ramsey averaging supplies finite chart laws and reversible matched-chart transport with independent uniform letters and arbitrarily small stationary one-step failure probability (lem:order-averaging and prop:chart-transport).

CPrefixDisplacement.statement: For every positive n, every all-good n-step chart trajectory of positive reduced length ell has raw label-sum norm at least ell/6 times the common raw one-step norm; half-open prefix cuts, negative labels, boundary margins, and endpoint compression are included.

CTwoLevels.statement: The periodic ping-pong action has inverse-odd cocycle cancellation; every nonempty reduced word has cocycle levels -n_minus and n_plus at the two interlaced orbit families (lem:action and lem:two-levels).

CReducedProbability.statement: An independent uniform four-letter word of length n >= 1 has reduced length at least n/4 with probability at least 1/4; intersecting all-good transport of failure at most 1/10 gives probability at least 3/20.

CMarkedLaw.statement: Edgewise detailed balance and row normalization define a probability law on valid marked paths, with invalid paths of mass zero and a stationary reversible induced state chain.
